title: Levidev Studio — Brand Identity & Logo Kit

sections.heading: 1. Icon Only (Symbol)
sections.body: Two rounded stone pillars (#B2A994) and two isometric rose strokes (#98585C) in light, dark, and animated SVG.

sections.heading: 2. Icon + Word Lockup (Square & Horizontal)
sections.body: Balanced combination mark pairing the original geometric symbol with outlined Avenir Roman typography and tracked STUDIO label.

sections.heading: 3. Full-Text Wordmark (Square & Wide)
sections.body: Typographic lockup led by the signature rose bar (#98585C) above Levidev and tracked STUDIO in light, dark, and animated SVG.

sections.heading: 4. Three-Column Hero Banners (Dark & Light)
sections.body: 904x256 README and profile banners with animated strokes, cursor blink, and the five-service studio index.
